title: Study Guide Generator — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Converts course material into organized, exam-ready study guides. The Study Guide Generator converts course material into organized study guides. It restructures chapters into sections with key terms, core ideas, worked examples, and common pitfalls, ending each section with self-test questions. The guide reads like a condensed version of the course, not a list of facts.
capabilities: Restructure chapters into guided sections with key terms
Add worked examples and common pitfalls per section
End sections with self-test questions
Condense material without losing core ideas
Organize guides by exam or by chapter
